name: Scry
text: Show the one tell this object hides.
backfire: The glass shows you something instead.

name: Hex
text: Weaken the seller's resolve: a lower price.
backfire: The hex turns on your purse.

name: Glamour
text: Make a buyer see more in your goods.
backfire: The glamour slips and the room notices.

name: Banish
text: Send a cursed object away and lower Dread.
backfire: It does not want to go.

name: Summon
text: Call a buyer for the goods you hold most of.

name: Seal
text: Seal the shop tonight: nothing wakes, but the landlord charges more.
backfire: The seal cracks before it sets.
